## Où j'en suis
The `cmd/replay` tool is written, with dry-run mode, per-partition ordering, a rejects file and a topic allowlist (commits 4e2d9b7 and f13a06c). The dry run on the 12/11 window (14:10–17:40 UTC) found 18,442,107 events to replay and 3,118 schema v2 lines to reject. The real replay has not run yet.

- [en-cours] PR #233 is open and waiting for Daniel's review.
- [prochaine-étape] Run the real replay into `events.replay.v3` with `--batch 5000`.
- [prochaine-étape] Then run the aggregator with `--backfill` for 2026-11-12.
- [essai-raté] A batch of 50000 was OOMKilled at the 2Gi limit; the memory limit stays as is because of the namespace quota.
- [décision] Replay everything into `events.replay.v3`, with no 72h cutoff, and never produce to `events.v3` from this tool (source: t05).
- [décision] Malformed schema v2 lines go to a rejects file in the bucket, not skipped silently (source: t15).
